source_message: Can you please grant me new staging read access for Beacon? Isla Morgan, Support. IT-009, submitted 2026-10-22. I need access to it from 2026-10-26 - 2026-10-29 to go through example support cases before updating our troubleshooting guide (we're missing a few steps new starters have been asking about). I've captured the questions in a document. I'd like to cross check with sample support cases first before I try writing the changes.
